run_tabular_training: run tabular model training by passing a training_config JSON file path to the argparse CLI entry point
train_tabular_model: train a tabular model for classification or regression using Optuna hyperparameter optimization and save the best model
optimize_hyperparameters: optimize model hyperparameters for xgboost, lightgbm, or randomforest using an Optuna trial and evaluation metric
parse_training_args: parse command line arguments to extract the training_config JSON file path for tabular training
review_optimize_function: review the optimize function that fits tabular models and calculates metrics for binary, multi-class, and regression tasks
